message: 乙女爆弾

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~ Here's a little treat for you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yesterday, I just kinda felt like~ baking a cake, you know~ So I went ahead and made one~」

name: Synn
message: 「You actually know how to cook, Sacchin...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You can get your hopes up, okay~? Even though it's my first time, I managed to make something that looks kinda edible~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's your first time... That doesn't count as knowing how to cook」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Now, now~」
When Sacchin pops open the box--

name: Synn
message: 「Uh... a strawberry shortcake?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-This is... Somehow, it's a cake that makes you want to paint an abstract masterpiece...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It looks like it got kicked by a horse... Which means this poor cake must have gotten in the way of someone's romance! I see, I see」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm completely at a loss for words」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, a plate and a knife ♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thank you~ Alright, here I go cutting it~ No hard feelings no matter how it turns out, okay~ Ready~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you raising a kitchen knife overhead?! And why are your eyes closed?!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll cut it」

name: Misa
message: 「Did you taste-test it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No way, that's way too scary~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're scared of it?!」
A slice is handed out to everyone, yet nobody touches theirs.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh~? Why isn't anyone eating~? I'm sure it's delicious~, probably」
For some reason, everyone looked at me. Does that mean they're counting on me?
As Student Council President, I cannot fail to live up to everyone's expectations!

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the food!」
Mustering up my courage, I brought a bite of the cake to my mouth.

name: Synn
message: 「...It's good!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You... you're acting like 'good' is the only word you know」

name: Synn
message: 「No, really! I'm not lying or anything--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... seriously?」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my? Regardless of how it looks, it actually tastes like a proper cake」

name: Ria
message: 「It's true... it's delicious」

name: Paqy
message: 「What the heck. It's totally edible」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho, this is quite delicious」
Nanaka steels herself as well and takes a big bite.

name: Sacchin
message: 「President, how did it turn out?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「39 points」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're so mean, Nana-chan. Don't grade a cake made by an amateur」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the one who asked!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So mean. Even though I managed to make an edible cake on my very first try. Somebody praise me」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, it was plenty good」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Getting praised by Synn-kun, whose entire vocabulary consists of 'good,' doesn't really help」

name: Ria
message: 「For a first attempt, this is really well done」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still... did you really make this, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I did! Believe me! I'm a member of the Sweets Appreciation Club too, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that supposed to be a jab at me?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「W-What could you possibly mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So even Sacchin can bake a cake...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yay! With this, the Sweets Club's dignity is preserved!」

name: Ria
message: 「Since Nanaka-chan is the president, I wonder if she can make something even more delicious?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since our treasurer makes delicious soba too, I'm sure she can make it!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm... really completely hopeless at anything other than soba, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've never even, aha, ahahaha... made a cake before」

name: Synn
message: 「Why don't you try making one too, Nanaka? No harm in trying. It might actually turn out pretty well」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Just like me~」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, there are plenty of people here to taste-test」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I said no! It'd be bad if someone ended up sick!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmph-hmph~ Then that settles it--I'm more impressive than the president~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-wh-what did you say?!」
Nanaka... Even though she loves sweets so much, why does she stubbornly refuse to make them herself?
